description: Bifacial single-diode model with front+rear thermal model. Rear cell runs slightly cooler than front due to lower irradiance absorption. F1b adds temperature model absent from F1a.

module.name: LG NeON 2 BiFacial 400W (n-type mono-Si bifacial)
module.source: LG NeON 2 BiFacial 400W datasheet; Deline et al. (2017) IEEE PVSC; Marion et al. (2017) IEEE JPV

gamma_pmp.note: Power tempco -0.37%/K for n-type mono-Si bifacial

rear_view_factor.note: Geometric fraction of albedo reaching rear

NOCT_front.note: NOCT for front-only illumination (800 W/m2, T_amb=20C)

rear_thermal_factor.note: Rear cell temperature rise is 85% of front rise. Rear receives less irradiance (albedo fraction) so heats less. Based on field measurements: Cvetkovska et al. (2021) IEEE JPV.

desoto_params.description: De Soto 5-parameter single-diode model at STC (front-side equivalent)
desoto_params.source: Fitted from LG NeON 2 BiFacial 400W datasheet
